description: Checks the verification code printed on an ONZIP condition report or lease PDF (8 characters, e.g. ABCD-EFGH): whether it was signed in ONZIP, the form and jurisdiction, when it was signed, which sides signed, and the SHA-256 of the final PDF. Give sha256 of the PDF in hand to check it is that exact file. Returns no names, addresses or home details.

code.description: Verification code from the PDF footer, e.g. ABCD-EFGH.

sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the PDF you hold.

name: onzip_verify_document
title: Verify an ONZIP-signed document
